english: You may discard as many Basic Energy cards as you like from your hand. This attack does 40 damage for each type of Basic Energy you discarded in this way.
chinese: 将自己手牌中任意数量的基本能量放于弃牌区，造成放于弃牌区的基本能量的属性种类数量×40伤害。

english: You may discard up to 2 Energy from your Benched Pokémon. This attack does 60 more damage for each card you discarded in this way.
chinese: 若希望，可以将最多2张自己备战宝可梦身上附着的能量放于弃牌区，追加造成其张数×60伤害。
